narrative.hero: Teaching machines to understand raw measurements, not images.
narrative.bio: My long-term goal is for the AI in future robots to understand raw sensor data directly: the physical parameters, the equations and the world behind every signal. Today I work on the extreme case, a single-pixel camera that records one number per illumination pattern and never forms an image; I design those measurements and train networks that act on the raw signal. The results hold where conventional pipelines struggle: through scattering, under measurement noise and below 1% sampling. At Politecnico di Milano I plan to carry this into time-domain diffuse optics, where the signal is the arrival time of photons that have travelled through tissue and the parameters to recover are how strongly the tissue absorbs and scatters light.

projects.title: The Lift Spectrum · Robust image-free sensing
projects.summary: Image-free sensing moves the hard problem to the 1D-to-2D lift; how adaptive that lift is decides robustness.
bullets: Showed that without reconstruction the 1D-to-2D lift is the design problem; mapped the lift spectrum.
Proposed STSF + TPLS: +3.2–9.9 pp over the prior image-free method (SPIFS); near-constant accuracy down to 0.78% sampling; up to +21.7 pp over clean-trained reconstruct-then-segment at 20 dB noise.
highlights: Up to +21.7 mIoU at 20 dB vs clean-trained reconstruct-then-segment
+3.2–9.9 mIoU vs the prior image-free method (SPIFS)
Runs on a real DMD bench without fine-tuning

projects.title: Sparse Hadamard single-pixel imaging
projects.summary: Orthogonal Hadamard patterns with tunable sparsity make single-pixel imaging robust through scattering and noise.
bullets: Gave orthogonal Hadamard patterns tunable sparsity: noise-robust imaging through scattering, low-order matrices that save memory, no training or post-processing.

projects.title: LDGI · Optical phased-array imaging
projects.summary: Line patterns from one-dimensional optical phased arrays break the noise symmetry ghost imaging relies on; LDGI overcomes it.
bullets: Showed that line patterns from one-dimensional optical phased arrays break the noise symmetry of ghost-imaging denoising; proposed LDGI (orders-of-magnitude gains), validated optically.
highlights: Orders-of-magnitude gain over traditional ghost imaging

platform_copy.linkedin_about_zh:
我是西安交通大学博士研究生，目前在米兰理工大学访问。我的长期目标是让未来机器人的 AI 直接读懂原始传感器数据：读懂每个信号背后的物理参数、方程与世界。目前我从最极端的情形做起：单像素相机对每个照明图案只记录一个数，从不形成图像；我设计这些测量，并训练直接作用于原始信号的网络。这些方法在传统流程吃力的地方依然有效：穿过散射介质、存在测量噪声、采样率低于 1%。在米兰理工，我计划把这条路线延伸到时域漫射光学：信号是穿过组织的光子的到达时间，要恢复的参数是组织对光的吸收与散射强度。

欢迎计算成像、免成像感知与机器感知方向的科研合作与研究实习交流。
